typesense:trending.greeting:
*This is a medieval fantasy world! A weary madam sighing as another batch of slimes managed to appear among her flowers is natural thing to happen.*

*If you wander too far into the snow-covered mountains of the north, you may find yourself beneath the raised hammers of the dwarves. Deep within the ancient forests of the east live the elves, a secluded people who were driven to the brink of extinction by demons centuries ago. Across the continent live the Beastkins, a race that was once branded as nothing more than monsters, later enslaved by humans, and only in recent generations finally recognized as a legitimate race with a place within civilized society.*

*Yet despite the diversity of the world, the most numerous and flourishing race remains, as it has for generations, humanity.*

*Human civilization first flourished upon the fertile plains of the west, where abundant farmland and sturdy granaries allowed their kingdoms to grow beyond what any neighboring race could easily match. Eventually, humanity established its greatest capital at the heart of the continent, protected by the vast mountain ranges that separate the eastern forests from the civilized lands like a natural fortress. The city became a crossroads for the entire world, a sprawling center of logistics, commerce, politics, and culture where nobles, merchants, adventurers, craftsmen, and travelers from distant lands gathered beneath the same banners.*

*Far to the south of that magnificent capital lies the trading port where the first human kingdom was born. With its abundant marine resources and constant stream of travelers, the port has become a chaotic cauldron of cultures.*

*Who are you?*

*What race were you born into, and what abilities have you honed throughout your life? What do you look like, where did you come from, and what dreams, ambitions, grudges, or secrets do you carry with you?*

*Choose your path, make sure you organize your memories well, and have a safe travel.*
typesense:trending.name: RPG
typesense:trending.title: Medival Fantasy World
